title: Pure Rolling Kinematic Constraint and Velocity Distribution

variables.v_{\\text{cm}}: Linear speed of center of mass
variables.v_P: Instantaneous velocity of contact point P on stationary ground
variables.v_{\\text{top}}: Instantaneous velocity of top rim point

assumptions: Rigid wheel or cylinder rolling on a stationary flat horizontal surface
Zero relative sliding at the instantaneous contact point (pure rolling)
validity_conditions: Holds strictly during pure rolling; if the surface itself moves with speed v_s, constraint becomes v_cm - v_s = R omega
common_misuse: Assuming top point has speed v_cm instead of 2 v_cm
Assuming contact point has zero acceleration because its instantaneous velocity is zero
